scoreDescription: Score = citationWeight × citationSignal + reputationWeight × reputationSignal. Citation weight rises linearly from 0 at release to 1 at 24 months; reputation weight is its complement. Citation signal = min(100, citations × 100 / 100000). Reputation uses the strongest sourced company affiliation, curated author, or publication-linked author h-index / 100, scaled to 100; signals do not stack. Missing signals remain unknown and their weights are not reassigned. Category cutoffs are calibrated separately for mature and recent papers around a 650-paper guide, staying stable within the configured count bands. Crowded months raise category cutoffs to keep at most 40 visible papers, with learning anchors retained. Only learning anchors and their prerequisites are reserved; all other papers need qualifying evidence and an actual graph connection. Hugging Face features prioritize enrichment, not score.
